name: select
title: Select
description: Single or multi choice field that composes Option List. Rows use List Item chrome. Configure width and open-list sizing. Closed list selection, not free-text autocomplete.

api.description: Select composes Option List for the open panel. SelectItem rows use List Item chrome; see the List Item page for size, muted or accent variants, asChild hosts, and fully configurable standalone rows. Configure root width, field chrome, trigger, value display, content, and items below. Root width sets the trigger; open-list width follows that mode unless SelectContent overrides alignItemWithTrigger. The trigger is a combobox with full keyboard support inherited from Option List.

groups.title: Select
groups.description: Root state for single or multi choice, open state, width, disabled, and validation.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Single value or multiple values.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value in single mode.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value in single mode.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the single value changes.

props.name: values
props.description: Controlled values in multiple mode.

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: Uncontrolled initial values in multiple mode.

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: Called when multiple values change.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state for the option list.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the panel opens or closes.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close after choosing a row. Defaults to true in single mode, false in multiple.

props.name: width
props.description: Root and trigger width. hug sizes to the value. fill stretches to the parent. Pass a CSS length such as 12rem for a fixed width. Fill and fixed also default the open list to match the trigger; hug defaults the list to hug option content. Override with SelectContent alignItemWithTrigger.

props.name: itemChrome
props.description: Default List Item chrome for every SelectItem (padding, gap, type size/family/weight/color, radius, fills, and stroke). Forwarded to OptionList. Per-item chrome props on SelectItem win. See List Item for the full chrome contract.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Non-interactive state with a muted fill, hairline border, and muted value text. Keeps the menu closed.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Validation state. Sets aria-invalid on the trigger and applies the destructive border with --focus-ring-error. Hint text stays muted.

groups.title: SelectField
groups.description: Optional label, subtext, and hint. Labels can sit above the control, overlap the top border, or stack inside the trigger.

props.name: label
props.description: Field title. outside renders above the control. overlap sits on the top border with a notch. inset stacks above the value inside the trigger.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: outside places the label above the field. overlap pins a compact label on the top border with a surface-colored notch. inset stacks a muted label above the value inside the trigger chrome.

props.name: subtext
props.description: Secondary supporting line. With outside, uses the kit Label subtext slot under the title. With overlap or inset, renders above the control. Pass a string or any custom node.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required mark on the label.

props.name: help
props.description: Help control after the label (for example SelectFieldHelp inside a Tooltip). With overlap or inset, sits beside the field title.

props.name: hint
props.description: Supporting text below the control. Pass a string or any custom node. Omit to hide. Stays muted in the invalid state.

props.name: hintColor
props.description: Hint color. Prefer tokens such as var(--muted-foreground). Sets --df-select-hint.

props.name: hintClassName
props.description: Additional classes on the hint line.

props.name: hintId
props.description: Id for the hint; pair with the describedby ARIA attribute on the trigger.

props.name: labelColor
props.description: Owned label color. Prefer tokens such as var(--foreground) or var(--muted-foreground). Sets --df-select-label. Overlap and inset default to muted-foreground.

props.name: labelClassName
props.description: Additional classes on the owned Label.

props.name: labelInsetAlign
props.description: Outside label inset. Forwards to Label insetAlign. content uses --df-label-inset-content on the field, which tracks --df-select-overlap-inset and --df-control-content-inset-inline.

props.name: labelInsetSize
props.description: Outside label custom inset. Forwards to Label insetSize when labelInsetAlign is custom.

props.name: invalidLabel
props.description: When Select invalid is true, tint the owned label with the error color. Set false to keep the label at its normal color.

props.name: errorLabelColor
props.description: Owned label color when invalid and invalidLabel are true. Prefer tokens such as var(--destructive). Sets --df-select-error-label.

props.name: overlapLabelBackground
props.description: Notch fill behind the overlap label. Match the surface behind the field. Prefer tokens such as var(--background). Sets --df-select-overlap-label-bg.

props.name: overlapInset
props.description: Distance from the trigger leading edge to the overlap label. Prefer spacing tokens. Align with trigger paddingLeft. Sets --df-select-overlap-inset.

props.name: overlapLabelPadding
props.description: Horizontal padding on the overlap label chip so the border notch clears the text. Prefer spacing tokens. Sets --df-select-overlap-label-pad.

props.name: overlapLabelSize
props.description: Overlap label font size. Prefer type tokens such as var(--df-text-11). Sets --df-select-overlap-label-size.

props.name: insetLabelSize
props.description: Inset label font size. Prefer type tokens such as var(--df-text-11). Sets --df-select-inset-label-size.

props.name: insetGap
props.description: Vertical gap between the inset label and the value. Prefer spacing tokens. Sets --df-select-inset-gap.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Associates the label with the trigger id.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout width and spacing for the field shell.

groups.title: SelectTrigger
groups.description: Combobox host for the visible control. Variant, sizes, padding, width, radius, and truncation are configured here.

props.name: variant
props.description: primary is a surface fill with a hairline border. secondary is a soft secondary wash with secondary-foreground value text and a transparent border.

props.name: size
props.description: T-shirt height and type size. "default" is an alias for "md".

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on all sides. Prefer spacing tokens such as calc(2 * var(--spacing-unit)). Sets each --df-select-padding-* side. Inset label position uses a roomier default recipe; these props override it.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal padding. Sets --df-select-padding-left and --df-select-padding-right. Overrides padding on those sides.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical padding. Sets --df-select-padding-top and --df-select-padding-bottom. Overrides padding on those sides.

props.name: paddingTop
props.description: Top padding. Prefer spacing tokens. Sets --df-select-padding-top and wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingRight
props.description: Right padding. Prefer spacing tokens. Sets --df-select-padding-right and wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.description: Bottom padding. Prefer spacing tokens. Sets --df-select-padding-bottom and wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.description: Left padding. Prefer spacing tokens. Sets --df-select-padding-left and wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Decorative icon at the start of the trigger, before SelectValue.

props.name: background
props.description: Trigger fill. Prefer tokens such as var(--background). Sets --df-select-bg and overrides the variant recipe.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Trigger border color. Prefer tokens such as var(--input). Sets --df-select-border.

props.name: hoverBorder
props.description: Instance hover border. Omit to inherit the theme. Set false to keep the resting border. Set true to force the hover border on. When set, the control writes data-hover-border; omit to inherit data-df-hover-border from the host.

props.name: hoverBorderColor
props.description: Hover border color when hover is active. Prefer tokens such as var(--foreground). Sets --df-select-hover-border. Focus and invalid borders take priority.

props.name: errorBorderColor
props.description: Invalid border color. Prefer tokens such as var(--destructive). Sets --df-select-error-border.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Overrides Select disabled when set on the trigger.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Overrides Select invalid when set on the trigger. Also accepts aria-invalid.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for shape and polish. Prefer Select width for hug, fill, or fixed sizing. Radius override examples: rounded-xl or rounded-full. Default radius uses the kit --radius-4xl token.

props.name: id
props.description: For label association and accessibility.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Point at SelectField hintId when a hint is shown.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Native invalid flag. Merged with Select invalid and the trigger invalid prop.

groups.title: SelectValue
groups.description: Shows the placeholder, selected label, or a custom render. When the selected SelectItem uses layout stacked with secondary, the trigger mirrors that stack. Compose kit Badge beside the label in SelectItem children to show a status pill in the trigger and list.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Pre-select copy when no value is chosen.

props.name: children
props.description: Static content or a render function with selectionMode, value, values, labelFor, secondaryFor, layoutFor, and toggleValue. Omit to use the label registered from SelectItem, including any Badge composed into that label. Default single-select render stacks title and description only when the selected item layout is stacked.

props.name: className
props.description: Value text styles. Truncation follows a fixed width trigger.

props.name: count
props.description: Primary count text, for example "2 selected".

props.name: supportingText
props.description: Muted secondary detail, for example "16 users".

groups.title: SelectValueBadge
groups.description: Multi-select chip used inside SelectValue. For a status pill on a single selection, compose Badge inside SelectItem children instead.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected option value; remove toggles this value off.

props.name: children
props.description: Badge label. Defaults to the registered option label.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Optional custom remove handler instead of toggleValue.

groups.title: SelectContent
groups.description: Open Option List panel. Same API as OptionListContent, including alignItemWithTrigger and searchBackground for the search field fill.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal anchor relative to the trigger. auto picks the best fit.

props.name: alignItemWithTrigger
props.description: Configure open-list width. true matches the trigger. false hugs the longest option (floored at --df-menu-min-width). Omit to follow the root width prop: hug defaults to false; fill and fixed default to true.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred placement side. Flips when there is not enough space.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between trigger and panel.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Shift along the alignment axis.

props.name: portal
props.description: Render in a portal. Set false for inline previews.

props.name: chrome
props.description: menu keeps popover fill, shadow, and radius. plain drops those so the list can sit inside a host surface. panel is a bordered card for always-visible lists.

props.name: background
props.description: Surface fill for any chrome mode. Sets --df-option-list-surface-bg. Prefer a token such as var(--card) or var(--popover).

props.name: foreground
props.description: Surface text color for any chrome mode. Sets --df-option-list-surface-fg. Header label inherits this color.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Outer surface stroke only. Sets --df-option-list-surface-border-color. Does not change header, search, or footer rules; use dividerColor for those.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Outer surface stroke width. Sets --df-option-list-surface-border-width. Prefer var(--border-width-hairline).

props.name: borderStyle
props.description: Outer surface stroke style. Sets --df-option-list-surface-border-style. Default solid.

props.name: dividerColor
props.description: Hairline rules on header, search, and footer. Sets --df-option-list-divider-color. Defaults to var(--border).

props.name: radius
props.description: Surface corner radius for any chrome mode. Sets --df-option-list-surface-radius. Prefer a radius token such as var(--radius-xl).

props.name: dismissOnScroll
props.description: Close when the page scrolls. Scrolling inside the list stays open. Set false to keep the panel following the trigger (it can cover sticky chrome).

props.name: header
props.description: Panel header above the options. Prefer OptionListHeader for a label, description, and edge-to-edge bottom rule. Stacks the panel like search and footer.

props.name: search
props.description: Show a search field above the options.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the search field.

props.name: searchBackground
props.description: Search field fill. Prefer tokens such as var(--muted). Forwards to SearchInput background. Named separately because background themes the panel surface.

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Controlled search query.

props.name: defaultSearchValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial search query.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Called when the search query changes.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Wrap options in the kit ScrollArea. Omit to default true when the panel has no submenu, and false when it contains a submenu.

props.name: scrollMaxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scrollable body before it scrolls. Omit for min(60vh, var(--df-menu-max-height)), or var(--df-menu-stacked-max-height) when header, search, or footer is present. When the panel opens, the selected option scrolls into the list scrollport while list order stays the same.

props.name: scrollThumbGap
props.description: Space on each side of the scrollbar thumb, in pixels. Omit to use --df-option-list-scroll-thumb-gap.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer actions under the options (for example Reset).

props.name: className
props.description: Panel surface styles.

groups.title: SelectItem
groups.description: Option row. Same API as OptionListItem. Forwards List Item presentation props (size, variant, slots, chrome). Selection state stays on Select. Open the List Item page for standalone rows and asChild links.

props.name: value
props.description: Option value stored in Select state.

props.name: size
props.description: List Item density. Forwarded to List Item. Use sm for compact nested submenu rows.

props.name: variant
props.description: List Item fill recipe. Forwarded to List Item. accent is the picker default; muted is for quiet nav-style rows.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not selectable row.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Presentational row. Forwarded to List Item. Not selectable and no hover chrome. Keeps resting and selected appearance.

props.name: leading
props.description: Option List leading slot. Pass an icon or other node for row icons; works with layout stacked. Use "checkbox" for multi-select. Pair with SelectTrigger leadingIcon when the trigger should mirror the selected icon.

props.name: leadingFit
props.description: Forwarded to List Item. icon keeps the mark box. content sizes the track to Avatar and other non-icon nodes. See List Item leadingFit.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Supporting copy beside or under the label.

props.name: layout
props.description: inline places secondary beside the label; stacked places it underneath; columns is leading, main, and trailing text with the main label horizontally centered in the row and height from content. With leading on stacked rows, the icon aligns to the title line. Select mirrors stacked layout in the trigger value.

props.name: trailing
props.description: End of row slot: badge counter, nested menu chevron, measure text, or both. When set, the selected check is hidden unless indicator is forced on. Submenu triggers pass the chevron here; List Item renders the trailing slot.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Selected check in single mode. Defaults off when leading is checkbox or trailing is set; otherwise on.

props.name: children
props.description: Primary label registered for SelectValue. Compose a kit Badge beside a text span to show a status pill in the list and trigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional row styles.

props.name: style
props.description: Host style. Merged after List Item chrome CSS variables.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on all sides. Forwarded to List Item. Sets each --df-list-item-padding-* side.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal padding. Forwarded to List Item. Overrides padding on those sides.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical padding. Forwarded to List Item. Overrides padding on those sides.

props.name: paddingTop
props.description: Top padding. Forwarded to List Item. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingRight
props.description: Right padding. Forwarded to List Item. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.description: Bottom padding. Forwarded to List Item. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.description: Left padding. Forwarded to List Item. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: gap
props.description: Minimum space between leading, label, trailing, and indicator. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Label type size. Forwarded to List Item. Prefer type tokens such as var(--df-text-11).

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: Label font family. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: fontWeight
props.description: Label font weight. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the row fill and stroke. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: background
props.description: Resting fill. Forwarded to List Item. Root itemChrome supplies defaults; per-item props win.

props.name: foreground
props.description: Resting label color. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: hoverBackground
props.description: Hover, highlight, and focus fill. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: hoverForeground
props.description: Hover, highlight, and focus label color. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: selectedBackground
props.description: Selected fill. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: selectedForeground
props.description: Selected label color. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: selectedHoverBackground
props.description: Selected row hover fill. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: activeBackground
props.description: Pressed fill. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Stroke width. Forwarded to List Item. Prefer var(--border-width-hairline). Default 0.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Stroke color. Forwarded to List Item. Prefer var(--border).

props.name: borderStyle
props.description: Stroke style such as solid or dashed. Forwarded to List Item.

groups.title: SelectFieldLabel
groups.description: Use when composing a field outside SelectField.

props.name: children
props.description: Label title content.

props.name: subtext
props.description: Secondary supporting line under the title. Same as Label subtext.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Associates the label with the SelectTrigger id.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required mark on the label.

props.name: help
props.description: Trailing help control after the label (typically SelectFieldHelp).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the Label root.

groups.title: SelectFieldHelp
groups.description: Help control for SelectFieldHelp inside a Tooltip.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the help button.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the help button.

props.name: children
props.description: Supporting text below the control. Pass a string or any custom node.

props.name: color
props.description: Hint color. Prefer tokens such as var(--muted-foreground). Sets --df-select-hint.

props.name: id
props.description: Hint id. Pair with aria-describedby on SelectTrigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the hint.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles on the hint. Can also set --df-select-hint for color.

groups.title: SelectGroup
groups.description: Groups related items. Alias of OptionListGroup.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the group.

props.name: children
props.description: Grouped rows and labels.

groups.title: SelectLabel
groups.description: Group heading inside the panel. Alias of OptionListLabel (ListItemLabel menu variant).

props.name: children
props.description: Heading copy.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the heading.

groups.title: SelectSeparator
groups.description: Horizontal rule between sections. Alias of OptionListSeparator.

props.name: inset
props.description: When true, inset the rule to match content padding. When false, span the full content width.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the rule.

groups.title: SelectScrollUpButton and SelectScrollDownButton
groups.description: Optional scroll affordances for long lists. Aliases of the OptionList scroll buttons.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the button.

groups.title: Layout and appearance
groups.description: Common configurations that are not single named props. Use className and tokens. Radius (CSS / className): Trigger uses the kit radius token. Override with className such as rounded-xl or rounded-full utilities. Corner shape (theme token): Curve style for rounded chrome. Set once with df-ui init --corner-shape (round or smooth), or override --df-corner-shape on :root. Fixed width (width CSS length): Pass a CSS length on Select such as 12rem or 200px. Multi-select badges wrap to new lines and the trigger grows in height. Text truncation (width CSS length): A fixed width that is shorter than the label ellipsizes SelectValue. The open list matches the trigger by default for fill and fixed width. Hug menu content (alignItemWithTrigger={false}): Menu width follows the longest option. Default when root width is hug, or pass false to override fill and fixed. Match trigger width (alignItemWithTrigger): Lock the menu to the trigger width. Default when root width is fill or fixed. List Item props (ListItem): SelectItem is OptionListItem. size, variant, slots, and chrome props forward to List Item. Open the List Item page for the full contract and use outside Select.

groups.title: Keyboard and accessibility
groups.description: The trigger is a combobox that owns open state and value display; the open list is an Option List panel. Open (Enter / Space / ArrowDown): Open the list from the focused trigger. Focus moves into the panel and lands on the selected option. Navigate (ArrowUp / ArrowDown / Home / End): Move the active option with wrap. Type to jump by label (typeahead) when the list has no search field. Commit and dismiss (Enter / Escape): Enter selects the active option. Escape closes the list and returns focus to the trigger. ARIA (combobox + listbox): The trigger sets aria-expanded, aria-haspopup="listbox", and aria-controls to the panel. Pair a label via SelectField or aria-describedby for hints. High contrast (forced-colors): Under forced-colors, the trigger keeps a border and selected or active rows use the system Highlight colors.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-menu-min-width
props.description: Minimum open panel width.

props.name: --df-menu-max-height
props.description: Maximum panel height before scrolling.

props.name: --df-select-padding-top
props.description: Top content padding. Set by padding, paddingY, or paddingTop. Inset label defaults to calc(3 * var(--spacing-unit)).

props.name: --df-select-padding-right
props.description: Right content padding. Set by padding, paddingX, or paddingRight. Defaults to --df-control-content-inset-inline. Inset label defaults to calc(3.5 * var(--spacing-unit)).

props.name: --df-select-padding-bottom
props.description: Bottom content padding. Set by padding, paddingY, or paddingBottom. Inset label defaults to calc(3 * var(--spacing-unit)).

props.name: --df-select-padding-left
props.description: Left content padding. Set by padding, paddingX, or paddingLeft. Defaults to --df-control-content-inset-inline. Inset label defaults to calc(3.5 * var(--spacing-unit)).

props.name: --df-select-hint
props.description: Hint line color. Set by SelectField hintColor or SelectFieldHint color.

props.name: --df-select-label
props.description: Owned label color. Set by SelectField labelColor. Overlap defaults to muted-foreground.

props.name: --df-select-error-label
props.description: Owned label color when invalidLabel is active. Set by SelectField errorLabelColor.

props.name: --df-select-overlap-label-bg
props.description: Notch fill for overlap labels. Set by SelectField overlapLabelBackground.

props.name: --df-select-overlap-inset
props.description: Leading inset for the overlap label. Set by SelectField overlapInset. Defaults to --df-control-content-inset-inline. Outside Label content mode on the field tracks this value.

props.name: --df-select-overlap-label-pad
props.description: Horizontal padding on the overlap label chip. Set by SelectField overlapLabelPadding.

props.name: --df-select-overlap-label-size
props.description: Overlap label font size. Set by SelectField overlapLabelSize.

props.name: --df-select-inset-label-size
props.description: Inset label font size. Set by SelectField insetLabelSize.

props.name: --df-select-inset-gap
props.description: Gap between inset label and value. Set by SelectField insetGap.

props.name: --df-select-error-border
props.description: Invalid trigger border. Set by SelectTrigger errorBorderColor.

props.name: --focus-ring-error
props.description: Invalid focus ring recipe shared with Input.

props.name: --df-select-icon-size
props.description: Leading icon box size on SelectTrigger. Scales with size.

props.name: --df-select-line-height
props.description: Value and placeholder leading. Paired with the size step as an even pixel value so single-line text centers without sub-pixel drift.

props.name: --df-select-bg
props.description: Trigger fill. Set by variant or the background prop.

props.name: --df-select-border
props.description: Trigger border. Set by variant or the borderColor prop.

props.name: --df-hover-border
props.description: Theme field hover border. on paints the ink hover border; off keeps the resting border. Runtime gating uses data-df-hover-border on html. Set with df-ui init --hover-border. Default on.

props.name: --df-select-hover-border
props.description: Hover border when the theme or instance enables hover. Defaults to the ink foreground. Override with hoverBorderColor.

props.name: --border
props.description: Panel and shared border token.

props.name: --background
props.description: Primary fill default.

props.name: --popover
props.description: Open panel fill.

props.name: --popover-foreground
props.description: Open panel text color.

props.name: --accent
props.description: Hover and highlight row fill.

props.name: --accent-foreground
props.description: Hover and highlight row text.

props.name: --df-corner-shape
props.description: Theme corner curve for all kit chrome. round = circular arcs; smooth = continuous squircle. Set with df-ui init --corner-shape, or override on :root. Default round.
